test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a queue of 80 people, Angelina is 13th from the right and Margareta is 18th from the left. How many people are there between Angelina and Margareta?
solution:
• Total number of people = 80
 
• Position of Angelina from right = 13
 
• Position of Margareta from left =18
 
 
• Number of people between Margareta and Angelina = 80 - (18 + 13) = 49
 
 

Hence, **49** is the **correct answer.**
